prompt: Why should the imputer and the scaler be fitted on training rows only?
options: Because the test rows are too few to matter
Because the learned numbers would otherwise carry information from the rows the model is judged on
Because fitting on all rows is slower
Because scalers cannot be fitted twice
explanation: A learned statistic that includes the test rows leaks information about them into the preprocessing, and the score becomes optimistic.

prompt: A column is only filled in after a customer cancels, and it predicts cancellation perfectly. What is the right action?
options: Keep it, since it predicts well
Remove it, because it is target leakage and will not be available when predictions are needed
Scale it more carefully
Use it only in the test set
explanation: A feature that is only known after the outcome makes a perfect score meaningless. It cannot be used on the day predictions are needed.

prompt: What does one-hot encoding a category column do?
options: Assigns each category a number that increases with its importance
Gives each category its own 0/1 column, so the model does not assume an order
Removes rare categories
Averages the target for each category
explanation: Numbers assigned to categories imply an order and a distance that do not exist. Separate 0/1 columns avoid that assumption.

prompt: In a grid search, what is the honest way to estimate the score of the chosen setting?
options: Report the best cross-validation score
Evaluate the chosen setting once on a test set that the search never saw
Report the training score
Average the scores of all settings
explanation: The cross-validation score that selected the setting is optimistic, because the search picked the best of many. Only a test set untouched by the search gives an unbiased estimate.

prompt: Permutation importance of a feature is large. What does that tell you?
options: The feature causes the target
The model's error rises a lot when the feature is shuffled, so the model relies on it
The feature has the largest values
The feature has no correlation with other features
explanation: Permutation importance measures reliance by the model, not causation. Correlated features can also share credit, so the ranking needs care.
